description: Build an unsigned redeem transaction to withdraw from an Arcadia lending tranche (ERC-4626). Burns tranche shares and returns the corresponding amount of underlying asset, including accrued interest. The owner must be the shares holder; receiver is where the underlying asset is sent.

owner.description: Address that owns the tranche shares being burned. Normally the signer's own wallet.

receiver.description: Address that receives the underlying asset. Usually the owner's own wallet.

shares.description: Amount of tranche shares to burn, in raw units. To redeem everything, use the owner's full share balance.

tranche_address.description: Tranche contract address (ERC-4626 vault). Get this from read.pool.list — each pool's `tranches[0].address`.

name: write.pool.redeem
